candidates.statement: Use Uber for transportation to get from one place to another.
context: Typically for places the stakeholder could walk to

evidence_candidates.quote: the main goal is transportation to get from one place to another

candidates.statement: Decide whether to take a ride by the time it will take and the price, and walk instead when a ride would take too long.
context: Deciding whether to take a ride at all

evidence_candidates.quote: it's usually the amount of time it will take or the price in deciding whether or not to take ride
I'll just walk even if it's kind of far away

candidates.statement: Choose the cheapest ride option when booking, except when traveling with more people, where a larger four-seat car is chosen.
context: Traveling with more people

evidence_candidates.quote: I usually just go for The cheapest one, to be honest, unless if i'm going with more people

candidates.statement: Wait instead of booking when the quoted price is too high.
context: When the quoted price is too high and the trip can wait

evidence_candidates.quote: if the price was too high, then I can choose to wait

candidates.statement: Usually book a ride for now rather than scheduling it for later.

evidence_candidates.quote: I can also book it uh for now or later, I usually just do now. I rarely book something in the future.

candidates.statement: See address suggestions while typing a destination so the address can be picked before typing is finished.

evidence_candidates.quote: a couple of different options pop up as I'm typing it, which is kind of helpful

candidates.statement: See nearby cars on a map to know whether other drivers are around.

evidence_candidates.quote: I can also see a map with a couple different Ubers around. So I can know if there are other drivers near me.

candidates.statement: Booking a driver that the app shows nearby completes quickly instead of taking a long time or ending with the app saying it cannot find a driver.
context: When the app shows a driver nearby but the rider has to wait

evidence_candidates.quote: sometimes when I click okay and try to book that driver, it will take a really long time to actually schedule it. And sometimes it will end up saying that can't find a driver

candidates.statement: Avoid cancelling a booked ride because cancellations damage the passenger rating.
candidates.modality: usually try not to（习惯性避免）
context: Reason: drivers see the passenger rating

evidence_candidates.quote: I usually try not to cancel a ride because I think that that damages my like the drivers will see a rating of the passenger as well.

candidates.statement: Not have to start a ride in order to cancel it.

evidence_candidates.quote: I kind of wish that I don't want to just start a ride to cancel it.

candidates.statement: Prefer renting a car for work travel or travel in general.
context: Depends on how walkable the area is and how much driving is needed

evidence_candidates.quote: Most of the time when I book or when I'm traveling for work or just traveling in general, I would probably prefer to rent a car.

candidates.statement: On work trips covered by the employer, care less about price and more about time, accepting extra cost to avoid waiting.
context: Work travel where the employer covers the cost

evidence_candidates.quote: on the times where I have needed to to use a rideshare for work i usually care less about the price and more about the time in that case because my work is going to cover it
I don't care if it's an extra $20 for not having to wait an extra 20 minutes

candidates.statement: Take the bus for planned routes, especially work trips with a free bus pass.
context: Work provides a free bus pass

evidence_candidates.quote: So I usually do take a bus for my like planned route.
My work gives me a free bus pass, basically.

candidates.statement: Avoid taking the bus in areas the stakeholder is not familiar with.
context: When the area is unfamiliar

evidence_candidates.quote: I don't want to take a bus in a place I'm not familiar with

candidates.statement: Prefer Uber over the bus when the bus trip would be long or require walking or several buses.
context: When the bus route is complicated, long, or requires walking or several buses

evidence_candidates.quote: And so if it's complicated like that, I would probably prefer And Uber in that case.

candidates.statement: Rent a car for a week-long vacation with substantial travel, for more freedom than repeated ride shares.
candidates.modality: would make more sense（条件性偏好）
context: Trip of about a week with a decent amount of travel

evidence_candidates.quote: then it would make more sense and give me a little bit more freedom to rent a car than to do a ride share every time I want to go someplace.

candidates.statement: Stop using Uber Eats after the bad experience with it.
context: Reason: bad time estimate and poor customer service

evidence_candidates.quote: That is something that I have had bad experiences with, so I've stopped using it.
It was a mixture of a bad estimate poorly estimating the amount of time And then the customer service dealing with that was extraordinarily poor.

candidates.statement: The bad Uber Eats experience came from a badly estimated time and extraordinarily poor customer service.

evidence_candidates.quote: It was a mixture of a bad estimate poorly estimating the amount of time And then the customer service dealing with that was extraordinarily poor.

candidates.statement: Talk to a person at customer service when trying to resolve an issue.
context: When an issue needs to be resolved rather than a specific question answered

evidence_candidates.quote: I found it very difficult because I wanted to talk to a person
if you actually want to actually resolve an issue, you're probably going to need more than what they're like

candidates.statement: Be charged exactly the amount quoted for rides and Uber Eats orders.

evidence_candidates.quote: the amount of money that they charged me was the amount of money that they said that they were going to charge me

candidates.statement: Prefer a single destination over multiple stops when taking an Uber.
context: Multi-stop is still used occasionally

evidence_candidates.quote: Most of the time, if I'm going to use Uber, I would prefer to just go to one location versus going to multiple ones.

candidates.statement: Keep the in-between stops on a multi-stop trip as quick as possible.
context: Only when a multi-stop trip is used

evidence_candidates.quote: I always feel weird if I'm going to do that where one of the in-between stops takes too much time So I try to to do anything like that. I try to make it as quick as possible

candidates.statement: Share the trip location with other users for tracking.

evidence_candidates.quote: I have not shared my location with somebody

candidates.statement: Contact the driver through the app's call or messaging feature to coordinate the pickup.
candidates.modality: very helpful（正面评价＋实际使用）
context: When the pickup point is hard to find or the area is busy
Also used during multi-stop trips to explain delays

evidence_candidates.quote: Yeah, I have used that before. I actually find that very helpful.
So calling or calling usually calling on their way to pick me up is usually really helpful

candidates.statement: Change the pickup location in the app easily after it has been set from the current location.
candidates.modality: 抱怨＋绕行做法（now only easy if...）
context: After the pickup point has been set from the current location

evidence_candidates.quote: It used to be relatively... easy if I'm remembering correctly. But now I think it's only really easy if you're not using your location from the start
But after you do that, I think that it's not as simple to change it.

candidates.statement: Tell the driver directly about a pickup change instead of changing the pickup location in the app.
candidates.modality: most of the time（实际做法，采访者确认其为 preferred）
context: When the pickup location needs to change after booking

evidence_candidates.quote: I think most of the time when I do want to change it, I give the driver a heads up instead of doing it on the app.
And directly contacting the driver is your preferred.

candidates.statement: Look at the ride fare after the trip to split the charge with friends or use it as a receipt for work reimbursement.
context: After the ride, for splitting with friends or work reimbursement

evidence_candidates.quote: I will go back And look at how much the ride was so that I could split split up the charge. Or if I'm doing it for work, then I can use that as a receipt to get reimbursed.

candidates.statement: Rate and tip the driver after the ride.

evidence_candidates.quote: they give you the option to rate the driver And you have the the option to tip the driver too
